claims.claim: ADM's Q2 oilseed Crushing operating profit increased by $330M year over year as global oilseed volumes rose about 5%, supported by biofuel economics and improved asset utilization.

Barcarena returned to full operations and higher South American soybean exports strengthened network utilization, while record meal exports from Brazil and the U.S. indicate strong global demand channels.

risks.risk: Results remain exposed to agricultural commodity spreads, energy prices, policy incentives and mark-to-market timing.

unknowns.unknown: Persistence of current crush and ethanol margin conditions through a normalized policy/energy environment is uncertain.

claims.claim: Ag Services & Oilseeds Q2 segment operating profit rose 129% to $867M; Carbohydrate Solutions operating profit rose 22% to $411M.
About $100M of net positive mark-to-market and timing impacts aided the quarter, so headline earnings strength is not entirely underlying run-rate improvement.

risks.risk: Policy incentives and favorable energy/corn economics contributed to ethanol performance, limiting confidence in straight-line extrapolation.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong segment profit growth includes meaningful favorable timing/mark-to-market effects and policy-sensitive economics.

unknowns.unknown: Normalized earnings power excluding timing and unusually constructive biofuel conditions remains uncertain.
